title: Decision on the Election of the Executive Committee of the Members of NACC Savings Cooperative Limited. / การตัดสินใจในการเลือกตั้งคณะกรรมการดำเนินการของสมาชิกสหกรณ์ออมทรัพย์ ป.ป.ช. จำกัด
author: Tippawan Peungpalamtan; ทิพวรรณ์ พึงปาลำธาร; Songserm Homglin; ส่งเสริม หอมกลิ่น; Sukhothai Thammathirat Open University; songserm.hom@stou.ac.th
category: เศรษฐกิจและการจัดการ
abstract: This study was a survey research, the objectives were to study, 1).Personal factors of members of the NACC Savings Cooperative Limited., 2) the decision-making level for the election of the Executive Committee of the Savings Cooperative of the National Anti-Corruption Commission Ltd., 3) the relationship between personal factors and candidate factors with decision making in electing the executive committee of members of the NACC Savings Cooperative Ltd.,and 4) problems and obstacles in deciding to elect the executive committee of the members of the NACC Savings Cooperative Ltd. The population were 2,530 members. Specifically Ordinary members with voting rights under the central and regional in 2024. The sample was determined by Taro Yamane's formula. Samples At a deviation value of 0.05 quantity 346 members. Research instruments were questionnaire. Data analysis using statistics. included frequency distribution. percentage, standard deviation, the Chi-squared test and content analysis. The study results were as follows: 1) Most members are female, range of the age between 40.34 years, status mostly single, education was bachelor's degree, income level 35,389.62 baht. and the period of membership between 7.81 years, and member status includes share capital between 50,001-100,000 baht, deposits less than 50,000 baht, and there is no credit with the cooperative. 2) The decision-making level in the election of the Executive Committee were the highest level were Cooperatives and cooperative operations. (mean 4.51) The applicant's qualifications are at the highest level. (mean 4.26) and candidate policy high level (mean 4.22), 3) Relationship of personal factors and candidate factors and decision-making in the election of the executive committee found that: (1) Qualifications of applicants It is related to all personal factors.
